carried_rule: Of the head's three seeds (st-s1..st-s3, best epoch), the carried head is the one with the median standardised summed score on validation (seed 314 scoring ordinals 500-1499; calib.gate4.summed_score scaled by the temperature's means on those rows; tma2-g4 on the validation scoring run's errors.npz).
shuffled_rule: The shuffled head (st-shuffled) is scored on validation at its best and at its last epoch, as distinct models (st-shuffled-best, st-shuffled-last). If either one's standardised summed score minus the temperature's (paired, clustered, 97.5%) lies wholly below zero, a G4-d pass is void (recorded as not passed). The test gate reads the outcome from validation.json by the digest in carried.json.
validation_rule: The carried head goes to test only if every check's point meets its band or limit on validation (G4-a coverage points inside [0.92, 0.98]; G4-b overall within +/-0.03 and every bin within +/-0.05; G4-c log gain above 0 and mean P at least 0.5; G4-d below 0; G4-e exact). Otherwise seed 320 is not generated and the record says so; the follow-on is decided as SRD section 5.
follow_on: SRD section 5: proposed in the write-up with a recommended default, adopted if the owner has not objected by the next spec. If only G4-d fails (or is void), the temperature's statement is carried. If G4-b or G4-c fails, the expected default is a statement that also gates on a causal manoeuvre flag (state 'course unknown' explicitly), since the oracle itself is overconfident on unsettled rows.
